purpose: Independent challenge of the availability scanner's positive evidence. This is a source audit, not a runtime capture or certification of every material.
scope: The original 404 obtainable classifications, registry coverage, XML producer semantics, transformation/reaction closure and image decoding/roles. The separate source review owns the original 14 exclusions and 48 unknowns.

registry.finding: 466 unique XML IDs exactly match the 466 report records. Historical API dumps cover all 465 non-air IDs and agree with runtime JSON array indices. Their originating build/executable is not recorded, so they corroborate registry shape but cannot independently certify the target build.
registry.requiredGuard: Persist engine numeric IDs explicitly; validate runtime fields against the selected build and do not assume a future JSON sort preserves index-to-ID mapping. Preserve duplicate XML definition order and establish the engine's overwrite semantics.

findings.observation: The report's recorded producer is a MaterialAreaCheckerComponent. It checks existing material and produces none.

evidence.finding: The matched material attribute belongs to the checker.
The component checks presence/fullness and sends a message.

replacementWitness.finding: Enabled converter changes existing glowstone_altar into templebrick_noedge_static.

findings.recommendation: Exclude detector components from producer extraction. Keep this material using the independently identified conversion route, conditional on an obtainable input.

findings.observation: The report uses PhysicsShapeComponent.material as a body-material producer, but the official documentation defines this field as collision audio selection.

evidence.finding: The circular collision shape has the misleading material field. A separate DamageModel ragdoll material exists, with DISINTEGRATED forced.
PhysicsShape material is for collision audio.
PhysicsImageShape material does create an image-based body.

findings.recommendation: Do not accept PhysicsShapeComponent.material as a cell-production witness. Record the separate ragdoll route as conditional until DISINTEGRATED behavior is established; do not claim the material is unused just because this proof fails.

findings.observation: The report accepts disabled/non-emitting components without their activation paths. Root growth has an explicit activation witness; rainbow gas relies on native effect behavior.

evidence.finding: The grow emitter starts disabled and is wired to nearby-player/damage events.
Both event callbacks enable the grow-tagged components.
RAINBOW_FARTS effect, real-particle emitter, initially is_emitting=0.

findings.recommendation: Require enabled/emitting/positive-count conditions or a source-specific activation witness. Preserve root_growth using its callback chain. Do not apply a blanket override for all disabled components.

findings.observation: Several reported material producers emit cosmetic particles only. That proves the content is used, but does not prove cells usable in reactions are produced by that route.

evidence.finding: The cited spark emitter emits cosmetic particles, with grid creation disabled.
The cited spark_teal route is cosmetic.
Docs distinguish grid cells, physical particles, and cosmetic particles with no other physical interactions.

findings.recommendation: Keep cosmetic use separate from physical availability. A 'used content' status can protect cosmetic materials; do not use a cosmetic witness as an obtainable reagent seed in reaction closure.

findings.observation: The regex misses documented defaults and several explicit producer attributes. wood_loose has ordinary world-generation routes omitted by the scanner.

evidence.finding: PixelSprite material defaults to wood_loose and makes sprite material cells/bodies.
Enabled PixelSprite omits material, so the documented default applies.
Inherits the default-producing structure.
World generation names that structure.
Enabled, non-visual vegetation explicitly creates wood_loose with positive probability.

findings.recommendation: Resolve XML inheritance/defaults and use component-specific fields. Missing fields include blood_spray_material, tree_material, chunk_material, shell_casing_material, on_death_emit_particle_type, create_cell_material and spark_material.

findings.observation: Any named transformation property of an obtainable source is accepted regardless of whether the triggering mechanism can run. Numeric material references are dropped entirely.

evidence.finding: air has default on_fire_flame_material=fire and on_fire_smoke_material=smoke despite burnable=false and generates_smoke=0. ice_static.warmth_melts_to_material is numeric370; the old scanner ignores it.
Sleep conversion, break conversion, heat conversion and collision reversion are separately configured mechanisms.
MagicConvert temperature mode explicitly invokes CellData cold/warm transforms.

findings.recommendation: Resolve numeric IDs against a validated registry. Gate each edge by its actual event mechanism, not just the target field. Do not infer that solid_on_collision_convert gates the separate collision splash material; native semantics must distinguish them. Retain unproved edges as candidates.

findings.observation: The scanner puts ReqReaction entries in the same closure as contact reactions. Local comments explicitly describe lack of a required neighbor, not contact with that neighbor.

evidence.finding: Plants become soil when the required air is missing; the ceiling plant has a directional condition.

findings.currentImpact: All five shipped ReqReaction outputs are soil/air, both independently available; this bug does not establish any new unavailable material in the original report.
findings.recommendation: Preserve reaction kind and interpret absence/direction separately. Do not require the absent neighbor as an available input. Track req_lifetime and other geometric conditions in evidence rather than dropping them.

findings.observation: All 42 original image-backed records have an actual material-layer call-site. The algorithm nevertheless only distinguishes visuals by filenames and ignores caller-supplied remappings and spawn colors.

evidence.finding: LoadPixelScene distinguishes materials/colors/background arguments and accepts color_to_material_table; RegisterSpawnFunction associates colors with callbacks.
The same material image is instantiated with different material-color mappings.
PixelScene declares separate material_filename/colors_filename/background_filename roles.

findings.recommendation: Record reference roles from actual XML attributes and Lua calls. Only material layers can support a Wang-color witness. Carry remappings and exclude spawn-marker colors in their biome context. Retain all42 role-backed witnesses, subject to their stated placement conditions.

findings.observation: Literal-path reachability from a whole Lua file includes dormant function bodies, zero-probability entries and overwritten Base attributes. It misses constructed paths, defaults and reaction-spawned entities.

evidence.finding: The fire_blue attribute is an override of the fourth inherited emitter; evaluating the fragment without its base loses actual emission flags.
A material reaction loads an entity, but materials.xml is omitted from the file-reference graph.
The engine expands $[0-4] image paths, not literal filenames.

findings.recommendation: Use source reachability as candidate discovery. Store at least one reviewed creation/activation witness for positive claims, resolve Base overrides, and include dynamic engine conventions explicitly. Never use this overapproximation as proof that all unvisited content is unused.

Apply Base overrides before choosing material.

create_real_particles => grid; emit_real_particles => physical particles; emit_cosmetic_particles alone => cosmetic use only.

Treat as conditional behavior, not direct entity spawn.

Record inventory existence separately from spill/leak capability when establishing physical-cell access.

Inventory and output modes.

load_this_xml_instead diverts output; follow that entity rather than assuming tree_material produces cells.

guards: Resolve owning component and explosion trigger/enable flags.
Create-cell probability and spark controls must permit output.
Native-specific config conditions need validation; a nested material name alone is not a production proof.

evidence.finding: Explosion branches have independent switches.

forbiddenProducerContexts: arbitrary Lua material= assignment without its table/consumer

transformationRulesToValidate.guard: Source must be able to enter the appropriate burning branch; smoke/flame generation counts must permit the output. Default field values on air/water are not production proof.
Resolve names/numeric IDs; provide an available cold/warm effect and enforce probability/don't-reverse rules. Numeric references are real edges, not absent values.
Record an attainable break or configured sleep-conversion event for an appropriate physical material; distinguish those events rather than treating the target as unconditional.
Collision splash is distinct from solid_on_collision_convert. Require appropriate physical-body/collision behavior and validate native splash threshold/power.
Provide an effect that invokes the native terrain-to-body conversion for this source. A target field alone does not identify an attainable trigger.

imageValidation.transparentRgbExplanation: pngjs zeroes RGB for a fully-transparent truecolor tRNS key; the custom decoder preserves hidden RGB. All dimensions, alpha and nontransparent RGBA agree. No runtime material has a zero-alpha Wang key, so this does not change material matches.
imageValidation.plz: Five signed-negative-dimension fragments contain only RGBA 00000000. No positive material proof depends on them. FastLZ has not been compared with an independent decoder in this review.
notes: Legitimate image role is necessary but not a complete runtime placement proof.
Spawn colors and color-to-material remapping must be evaluated in the caller's biome context.
The PNG comparison is independent decoding, not observed gameplay or a proof of map generation.

wangLookupGate.evidenceProvenance: Native worker evidence supplied by the parent agent; this source reviewer did not open a native session.
wangLookupGate.lookupKey: RGB (alpha stripped only after the gates)
wangLookupGate.helperScope: imageMaterialColors returns candidate RGB keys. mode=wang applies these gates; default conservative mode retains the union of known loading paths.
unresolvedContext: Alpha 0xfe invokes marker handling before the material lookup; its effects still need caller context.
Registered spawn callbacks and caller-provided material remappings must be evaluated separately.
wangLookupGate.tests: tests/material-source-analysis.test.js covers transparent RGB, black with nonzero alpha, opaque white, partially transparent white and an alpha-0xfe candidate.

fixedBitmapLookupGate.evidenceProvenance: Native worker finding supplied by the parent agent; exact evidence reference retained by the native worker.
fixedBitmapLookupGate.limitation: Only applies to this fixed-bitmap sampler; not a universal image-loading rule.

candidateHelper.meaning: Union of known Wang and fixed-bitmap candidate colors. Caller must resolve the actual image-loading role, marker handling and remapping before treating a color as a material assignment.

independentRegressionFixtures: A reachable MaterialAreaChecker material must not seed availability; an enabled converter with an available input must seed its paired output.
PhysicsShape collision-audio material must not seed physical material availability; a PhysicsImageShape image body may.
Cosmetic-only emitters protect content-use status but must not seed a physical reagent closure.
A disabled root_growth emitter remains dormant until its actual callback proof enables the grow tag; arbitrary disabled emitters remain unresolved.
PixelSprite with omitted material resolves to documented wood_loose after Base inheritance, unless a child overrides the material.

A material-colored pixel in a colors/background image is not terrain; the same bytes in a material role are a candidate, with color remapping applied. Explicit Wang mode rejects black RGB, alpha-zero and raw opaque-white; fixed-bitmap topology1 uses RGB without alpha/white gates. Default conservative mode keeps the union of possible colors. Alpha-0xfe still requires marker context.
Each ReqReaction fixture requires absence/direction semantics, while an ordinary Reaction requires contact.
The named numeric warm target370 resolves using the captured numeric registry, not a newly sorted array.
Source manifest, build identity or new unhandled producer fields invalidate a reviewed exclusion; changing only fixtures to mirror regenerated output is insufficient.
runtimeProbeNeeds: If native evidence is incomplete: capture exact CellFactory_GetAll* results, numeric-ID/name round trips and tags on the supported executable before any world transformations, recording executable/material hashes and active mods.
Resolve forced DISINTEGRATED ragdoll behavior and native RAINBOW_FARTS activation by focused native evidence or a declared runtime probe, rather than inferring it from config names.
If a classification still depends on undocumented body conversion or image substitution semantics, test that specific mechanism; failure to observe a material across seeds cannot prove it unused.
limits: No Noita runtime, browser, REA or Ghidra session was opened by this reviewer.
No claim is made that all 404 materials have individually certified gameplay witnesses.
No proposed exclusion is justified solely by absence of a literal material name.
Independent source role and decoder checks do not replace the separate review of the exclusions/native producer mechanisms.

evidence.finding: Registers spawn_root_grower and loads root_grower.xml.
The grow-tagged grid emitter starts disabled, creates root_growth, count6.
Player collision and damage events invoke root_grower_start.lua.
Both callbacks enable all grow-tagged components.

Source evidence, not a runtime observation.

flaskEligibilityReconstruction.scope: Only the four registry fields used by the native random-flask enumeration; does not certify natural occurrence or every other runtime field.

inheritance.finding: CellDataChild copies its parent; field loader overlays only present XML attributes, retaining inherited/default values for absent fields.

comparison.duplicateOutcome: Every duplicate alternative resolves to the same four eligibility fields; no duplicate precedence assumption affects these pools.

flaskPool.air: Excluded by the native registry enumerator; constructor default liquid type does not make special numeric slot0 a flask candidate.

flaskEligibilityReconstruction.independentTest: tests/material-source-analysis.test.js independently parses checked-in materials.xml with verified native defaults and compares all1864 reconstructed values to the runtime dump.

evidence.finding: GetTags takes numeric material ID and returns a table of strings; HasTag takes a string tag.
Shipped code calls CellFactory_HasTag with the literal bracketed tag [NO_FUNGAL_SHIFT].
Existing material dump stores bracketed tag strings.

tagProbeReview.probeAssessment: Calling CellFactory_GetTags(id), sorting its returned table and serializing the strings matches the documented interface. No existing independent GetTags runtime capture was found.
tagProbeReview.exactBracketOutput: Bracketed tag identity is supported by shipped HasTag usage, but GetTags wrapper output has not been independently checked by this reviewer. Keep exact comparison; do not silently strip brackets to make a capture pass.
